details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON beacon over HTTPS to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc carrying an X-Beacon-Package header. The transmitted fields are limited to the package name, os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), the npm/node version string, and the protocol; no environment values, tokens, credential files, or file contents are read or sent. index.js repeats the same beacon call on require and otherwise exports a Proxy of no-op functions so that imports of the package name do not crash. Certificate validation is disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). Reported for the record as security-research / proof-of-concept activity, not malware.
